podcast.title: Planned Woodstock 50 Performance
podcast.body: Cage the Elephant was part of the original lineup of 80 artists slated to perform at the Woodstock 50 festival in August 2019, which aimed to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the legendary Woodstock event. The festival was ultimately canceled due to a host of unresolved issues. "80 artists had originally signed up, including Santana, Dead & Company, The Killers, Jay-Z, Imagine Dragons, Cage the Elf and Miley Cyrus, Vampire Weekend, and more."

xref.title: Chess Player on the Road
xref.body: Matthew Schultz, the frontman for Cage the Elephant, utilizes his downtime while on tour by playing chess against the band's road crew. This provides him with a recreational activity during their extensive travel schedule. "Matthew Schultz of Cage the elephant spends his downtime on the road playing chess against the road crew."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: 60 Mind-Blowing Facts About Music in 60 Minutes: 2017 Edition

xref.title: Former Plumber
xref.body: Matt Shultz, the singer for Cage the Elephant, previously worked in construction, specializing in plumbing. "Plumbing was his specialty."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Sylvia Massey Production
xref.body: Glüleg's third album was produced by Sylvia Massey, a highly respected figure in music production with a resume that includes working with Tool, Red Hot Chili Peppers, System of a Down, and Cage the Elephant. Her involvement highlights the band's artistic credibility. "the third of which was produced by Sylvia Massey, a woman who has everyone from tool to the Red Hot Chili Peppers, to system of a down to cage the elephant on her resume."
